fullDescription: A high-end glassmorphism dashboard design system featuring soft mesh backgrounds, vibrant gradients, and edge-to-edge smooth SVG line charts. The aesthetic uses 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold, editorial headings and 'Satoshi' for clean body text. Suitable for premium SaaS, fintech, analytics platforms, and modern creative agency portals. Key elements include bento-grid layouts, ultra-blurred glass surfaces (28px blur), and floating 3D-inspired micro-interactions.
prompt:
## Resumo
A premium dashboard UI with a glassmorphic aesthetic characterized by multi-colored mesh backgrounds, high-transparency cards with heavy backdrop filters, and vibrant, smooth-curve SVG line charts. The layout uses a 12-column bento system with specialized project tracking and financial reporting widgets.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a mesh background using #f1f5f9 and radial-gradients at corners and center in indigo-600, violet-500, and pink-500 (15% opacity). Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for h1/h2/h3 titles. Main containers should be 'widget-cards' with: `background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(28px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); border-radius: 2rem;`. Hover state for cards: `translateY(-6px) scale(1.005)` with increased shadow. Secondary navigation should be a thin sidebar (w-24) with `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)` and 1px border-right. Use high-contrast gradients for primary actions: indigo-600 to violet-500. Buttons should have `shadow-indigo-600/20` and 16px border-radius.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar Navigation
A 96px wide sidebar with a glassmorphic background. Top features a 48px square logo with a gradient background (indigo-to-violet) and floating animation. Navigation icons are 48px square, rounded-2xl, with active states in solid indigo and inactive states in slate-400. Bottom section contains a profile avatar in a gradient border.

### Dashboard Header
Header contains a large H1 'Dashboard Overview' in Cabinet Grotesk and a welcome subtext. Right side features a 320px wide search bar with `background: white/70`, `backdrop-blur-md`, and an icon prefix. Notification button is a 48px glass square.

### Project Tracker Widget
A 3-column span card. Vertical list of projects featuring 40px rounded-xl icons. Each item has a title, sub-label, percentage text, and a 6px high progress bar. Progress bars must have a gradient fill and a 'glow' shadow matching the brand color (e.g., orange-400 with orange-shadow).

### KPI Chart Grid
Three 4-column cards. Card 1: Horizontal bar chart with 10px rounded-full indigo bars. Card 2: Edge-to-edge smooth SVG curve in Rose-500 with a matching gradient fill (30% to 0% opacity) and a blur-aura underneath. Card 3: Circular progress gauge (78%) with a 10px stroke-width and amber-500 color.

### Earning Reports Section
A full-width (12-column) widget. Left side: two large KPI stats with 56px rounded-2xl icon backgrounds and mini spark-lines. Right side: A 7-day bar chart where the active day (Friday) is a 40px wide indigo pillar with a high-glow shadow, while inactive days are light indigo-100/40.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Smooth Edge-to-Edge Line Chart — SVG line chart with continuous curves and area fill.
SVG path with `fill: none; stroke: #f43f5e; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round;`. Below the stroke, an area path `fill: url(#gradient)` where the gradient transitions from stroke-color (opacity 0.3) at top to transparent at bottom. The chart must use a bezier curve `M0,30 C20,10 40,50 60,20 S80,10 100,30` ensuring horizontal span is 100% of parent width.

### Glass Hero Promo Card — High-impact gradient card for events or featured content.
Card with top-half background `gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 via-indigo-500 to-violet-600`. Center features a 80px play button in `white/20` backdrop-blur with a 1px white border. Content area uses `p-8` padding with high-contrast text and a full-width indigo primary button.

## Notas Especiais
Must maintain a high border-radius (min 2rem/32px) for all main containers to ensure a soft aesthetic. Must use edge-to-edge SVG paths for charts—lines must touch the horizontal container boundaries. Do not use solid, flat background colors; always use translucent white with backdrop-blur. Do not use standard system fonts for headings; Cabinet Grotesk is critical for the 'premium' feel.

style.description: Typography: Headings use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (700-800 weight) with tight tracking; body uses 'Satoshi' or 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Colors: Background is #f1f5f9 with radial gradients of Indigo (#4f46e2), Violet (#7c3aed), Pink (#ec4899), Emerald (#10b981), and Amber (#f59e0b). Glass: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) with 28px backdrop-filter and 1px border of white at 50% opacity. Animation: 3s float keyframes and cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transitions for hover scales.
